questions.text: Is the organisation a financial entity of a type listed in Art. 2(1) (bank, payment or e-money institution, investment firm, insurer, crypto-asset service provider and others)?
Does it supply ICT services to financial entities?
Is it one of the entities Art. 2(3) leaves out?
Does the simplified ICT risk framework of Art. 16 apply to it?
Has the authority identified it for threat-led penetration testing?

outcomes.reason: Financial customers pass the contract terms of Art. 28 to 30 on to their providers.
The Regulation addresses financial entities. Confirm with your adviser.
Art. 2(3) leaves this type of entity out. Confirm with your adviser.
